SELECT DISTINCT STRUCTURE_NAME FROM T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND STRUCTURE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC = #{mainMaterialDesc} AND STRUCTURE_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{structureName}), '%')
GROUP BY STRUCTURE_NAME
SELECT a.* FROM T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF a LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO b ON a.MATERIAL_CODE = b.MATERIAL_CODE ${ew.customSqlSegment}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO t1 JOIN T_MDM_SKU_CONSTRUCTION_REF t3 ON t1.MATERIAL_CODE = t3.MATERIAL_CODE JOIN T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF t2 ON t2.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC = t3.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC SET t1.STRUCTURE_NAME = t2.STRUCTURE_NAME, t1.UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, t1.UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE t1.IS_DELETE = 0 AND t2.IS_DELETE = 0 AND t3.IS_DELETE = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF( FACTORY_CODE, MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME ) SELECT t1.FACTORY_CODE, t1.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, #{createBy}, #{createTime} FROM T_MDM_SKU_CONSTRUCTION_REF t1 WHERE t1.IS_DELETE = 0 AND t1.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM T_MDM_SKU_STRUCTURE_REF t2 WHERE t2.IS_DELETE = 0 AND t2.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC = t1.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC ) GROUP BY t1.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, t1.FACTORY_CODE
